```{r calculate disturbance effects}
# Global 4-day LAI data
data_LAI <- read.csv(file.path(dir_rawdata, "LAI_4day_allsites", 'trend-combined-MCD15A3H-061-results.csv'))
# 
data_LAI$MCD15A3H_061_Lai_500m[data_LAI$MCD15A3H_061_Lai_500m > 20] = NA



# do one study site only
data_LAI_be_vie <- data_LAI %>% filter(ID == "BE-Vie") %>% filter(between(year(ymd(Date)), 2010, 2023))
data_LAI <- bind_rows(data_LAI_be_vie, data_LAI[data_LAI$ID != "BE-Vie", ])


# plot(data_LAI$MCD15A3H_061_Lai_500m)

# If a site is in southern hemisphere
sites_long <- read.csv(file.path('data2026', 'long_term_ec_sites.csv'))
sites_south_hemisphere <- sites_long$site_ID[sites_long$Lat < -10]

data_LAI_north <- data_LAI %>% 
  filter(!ID %in% sites_south_hemisphere) %>%
  mutate(Date = ymd(Date)) %>%
  mutate(year = year(Date), doy = yday(Date)) %>%
  # filter(MCD15A3H_061_FparLai_QC_CloudState == '0b00') %>%  # MCD15A3H_061_FparLai_QC_MODLAND == '0b0' & 
  # MCD15A3H_061_FparExtra_QC_Aerosol == "0b0"; MCD15A3H_061_FparExtra_QC_Cloud_Shadow == "0b0"
  # MCD15A3H_061_FparExtra_QC_Internal_CloudMask == '0b0'
  dplyr::select(ID, Date, year, doy, MCD15A3H_061_Lai_500m, MCD15A3H_061_FparLai_QC_MODLAND, 
         MCD15A3H_061_FparLai_QC_CloudState, MCD15A3H_061_FparExtra_QC_Aerosol, 
         MCD15A3H_061_FparExtra_QC_Cloud_Shadow, MCD15A3H_061_FparExtra_QC_Internal_CloudMask) %>%
  rename(LAI = MCD15A3H_061_Lai_500m) %>%
  arrange(ID, year, doy)

data_LAI_south <- data_LAI %>% 
  filter(ID %in% sites_south_hemisphere) %>%
  mutate(Date = ymd(Date), year = year(ymd(Date))) %>%
  mutate(doy = case_when(leap_year(year) & month(ymd(Date)) < 7 ~ yday(Date) - 182 + 366, 
                         leap_year(year) & month(ymd(Date)) >= 7 ~ yday(Date) - 182,
                         !leap_year(year) & month(ymd(Date)) < 7 ~ yday(Date) - 181 + 365, 
                         !leap_year(year) & month(ymd(Date)) >= 7 ~ yday(Date) - 181)) %>%
  # filter(MCD15A3H_061_FparLai_QC_CloudState == '0b00') %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, Date, year, doy, MCD15A3H_061_Lai_500m, MCD15A3H_061_FparLai_QC_MODLAND, 
         MCD15A3H_061_FparLai_QC_CloudState, MCD15A3H_061_FparExtra_QC_Aerosol, 
         MCD15A3H_061_FparExtra_QC_Cloud_Shadow, MCD15A3H_061_FparExtra_QC_Internal_CloudMask) %>%
    rename(LAI = MCD15A3H_061_Lai_500m) %>%
    arrange(ID, year, doy)
  
data_LAI <- bind_rows(data_LAI_north, data_LAI_south)

  # LAI data at IT-Cp2 and >= 2020 had abrupt change, so not used.
data_LAI <- data_LAI %>% filter(!(ID == "IT-Cp2" & year >= 2020))


LAI_seasonal_pattern <- data_LAI %>% 
  filter(MCD15A3H_061_FparLai_QC_CloudState == '0b00') %>% 
  filter(MCD15A3H_061_FparExtra_QC_Aerosol == '0b0') %>% 
  filter(MCD15A3H_061_FparExtra_QC_Cloud_Shadow == '0b0') %>% 
  filter(MCD15A3H_061_FparExtra_QC_Internal_CloudMask == '0b0') %>% 
  # filter(MCD15A3H_061_FparLai_QC_MODLAND == '0b0') %>%
  group_by(ID, doy) %>% 
  summarise(LAI = mean(LAI, na.rm = T), .groups = "drop") 

# read in start and end of growing season
data_grow_season <- read.csv(file.path('data2026', 'growing_season_yearly.csv'))
grow_season_site <- data_grow_season %>%
  group_by(site_ID) %>% 
  summarise(sos=floor((mean(sos_DER) + mean(sos_TRS)) / 2), 
            eos=ceiling((mean(eos_DER) + mean(eos_TRS)) / 2))

source(file.path("scripts2026", "00_functions.R"))
grow_season_site <- bind_rows(grow_season_site, data.frame(site_ID = sites_grow_yearlong, sos = 1, eos = 365))

#
sites_all <- unique(sites_long$site_ID)
LAI_seasonal_pattern_smooth <- data.frame(site_ID = character(), doy = integer(), LAI_gam = double())
for (site in sites_all) {
  tmp <- LAI_seasonal_pattern %>% filter(ID == site) 
  plot(tmp$doy, tmp$LAI, main = site)
  # adding lines of growing season
  sos <- grow_season_site$sos[grow_season_site$site_ID == site]
  eos <- grow_season_site$eos[grow_season_site$site_ID == site]
  points(x = c(sos, eos), 
         y = c(mean(tmp$LAI, na.rm=T), mean(tmp$LAI, na.rm=T)), col = 'red', pch = 19)
  
  # smooth the seasonal pattern (losses, or gam)
  loess_model <- loess(LAI ~ doy, data = tmp)
  gam_model <- gam(LAI ~ s(doy), data = tmp)
  #
  df <- data.frame(site_ID = site, doy = sos:eos)
  df$LAI_loess <- predict(loess_model, newdata = df)
  pred <- predict(gam_model, newdata = df, se.fit = TRUE)
  df$LAI_gam <- pred$fit - pred$se.fit * 1.96 # consider noise effects
  # we finally decided to use LAI_gam, because it matches seasonal pattern better. 
  #
  lines(df$doy, df$LAI_loess, col = 'yellow')
  lines(df$doy, df$LAI_gam, col = 'blue')
  
  LAI_seasonal_pattern_smooth <- bind_rows(LAI_seasonal_pattern_smooth, df)
}

# we should use the gam smoothed line. 
# How many site-years have been missing in the data?
data_LAI <- data_LAI %>%
  mutate(weight = case_when(
    MCD15A3H_061_FparLai_QC_CloudState == '0b00' & MCD15A3H_061_FparExtra_QC_Aerosol == '0b0' &
    MCD15A3H_061_FparExtra_QC_Cloud_Shadow == '0b0' & MCD15A3H_061_FparExtra_QC_Internal_CloudMask == '0b0' &
    MCD15A3H_061_FparLai_QC_MODLAND == '0b0' ~ 1,
    MCD15A3H_061_FparLai_QC_CloudState == '0b00' & MCD15A3H_061_FparExtra_QC_Aerosol == '0b0' &
    MCD15A3H_061_FparExtra_QC_Cloud_Shadow == '0b0' & MCD15A3H_061_FparExtra_QC_Internal_CloudMask == '0b0' &
    MCD15A3H_061_FparLai_QC_MODLAND != '0b0' ~ 0.5,
    TRUE ~ 0)) %>%
  left_join(LAI_seasonal_pattern_smooth, by = c("ID" = "site_ID", "doy"))
  
df_disturbance <- data.frame()
for (site in sites_all) {
  # site = 'CA-Cbo'
  print(site)
  #
  data_LAI_site <- data_LAI %>% filter(ID == site) 
  
  f_good_data <- data_LAI_site %>% group_by(year) %>% summarise(f = sum(weight == 1) / n()) 
  # remove a year if it has < 50% of average data
  bad_years <- f_good_data %>% filter(f < mean(f_good_data$f, na.rm=T) * 0.5) %>% pull(year)
  if (length(bad_years) > 0) {
    data_LAI_site <- data_LAI_site %>% filter(!year %in% bad_years)
  }
  
  # interpolate missing points
  data_LAI_site$LAI_intp <- data_LAI_site$LAI
  data_LAI_site$LAI_intp[data_LAI_site$weight == 0] <- NA
  data_LAI_site$LAI_intp[data_LAI_site$weight == 0.5 & data_LAI_site$LAI_intp < 0.5 * data_LAI_site$LAI_gam] <- NA
  data_LAI_site$LAI_intp <- approx(
    x = as.numeric(data_LAI_site$Date),    # time axis as numeric
    y = data_LAI_site$LAI_intp,            # values to interpolate
    xout = as.numeric(data_LAI_site$Date), # points where we want the output
    method = "linear",
    rule = 2                               # optional: extrapolate endpoints
  )$y

  #
  # get trend of growing-season LAI
  sos <- grow_season_site$sos[grow_season_site$site_ID == site]
  eos <- grow_season_site$eos[grow_season_site$site_ID == site]
  yearly_LAI_site <- data_LAI_site %>% filter(between(doy, sos, eos)) %>%
    group_by(year) %>% summarise(LAI_gs = mean(LAI_intp, na.rm=T), .groups = "drop")
  
  # correct trend's effect  
  fit <- lm(data = yearly_LAI_site, LAI_gs ~ year)
  summary(fit)
  
  if (summary(fit)$coefficients["year", "Pr(>|t|)"] < 0.05) {
    trend_annual <- fitted(fit)
    data_LAI_site <- data_LAI_site %>% left_join(data.frame(year = yearly_LAI_site$year, trend = trend_annual), by = "year")
    data_LAI_site$LAI_intp_detrend <- data_LAI_site$LAI_intp - data_LAI_site$trend + mean(data_LAI_site$trend, na.rm = T)
    # plot(data_LAI_site$LAI_intp_detrend)
    # plot(data_LAI_site$LAI_intp)
  } else {
    data_LAI_site$LAI_intp_detrend <- data_LAI_site$LAI_intp
  }
  
  # deal with NA values, which will not be used in curve fitting
  # data_LAI_site$LAI[is.na(data_LAI_site$LAI)] <- 0
  # data_LAI_site$weight[is.na(data_LAI_site$LAI)] <- 0
  
  # smooth out data_LAI_site; we do not need this any more. 
  # INPUT <- check_input(t = data_LAI_site$Date, y = data_LAI_site$LAI, w = data_LAI_site$weight, nptperyear = 92)
  # fit <- smooth_wSG(as.numeric(INPUT$t), INPUT$y, INPUT$w, nptperyear = 92)
  # fit_whit <- smooth_wWHIT(t = as.numeric(data_LAI_site$Date), 
  #                   y = data_LAI_site$LAI, ylu = 0,
  #                   w = data_LAI_site$weight, lambda = 50, 
  #                   nptperyear = 92)
  #
  # fit <- smooth_wSG(t = as.numeric(data_LAI_site$Date), 
  #                   y = data_LAI_site$LAI,
  #                   w = data_LAI_site$weight, nptperyear = 92)
  # The SG method is also not stable, and not used. 

  # plot(data_LAI_site$Date, data_LAI_site$LAI, pch = 16, col = "grey")
  # # lines(data_LAI_site$Date, fit$zs$ziter2, col = "blue", lwd = 2)
  # lines(data_LAI_site$Date, fit_whit$zs$ziter1, col = "yellow", lwd = 2)
  # lines(data_LAI_site$Date, data_LAI_site$LAI_gam, col = "red", lwd = 1)
  
  # data_LAI_site$LAI_whit =  fit_whit$zs$ziter1
  # data_LAI_site$LAI_sg =  fit$zs$ziter2
  
  # check disturbance data of a year, only used during debugging. 
  # data_LAI_site %>% filter(year %in% c(2011:2023)) %>%
  #   mutate(month = month(Date)) %>% filter(between(month, 1, 12)) %>%
  # ggplot() +
  #   geom_line(aes(x = Date, y = LAI_gam), col = 'red') +
  #   # geom_line(aes(x = Date, y = LAI_intp), col = 'black') +
  #   geom_line(aes(x = Date, y = LAI_intp_detrend), col = 'blue') +
  #   labs(title = site)

  # calculate disturbance effects
  LAI_gs <- mean(data_LAI_site$LAI_gam[between(data_LAI_site$doy, sos, eos)], na.rm = T) * (eos - sos + 1)
  df <- data_LAI_site %>% filter(between(doy, sos, eos)) %>%
    mutate(deficit_obs = pmax(LAI_gam - LAI_intp_detrend, 0)) %>%
    group_by(ID, year) %>%
    summarise(deficit_obs = sum(deficit_obs, na.rm=T) * 4 / LAI_gs, .groups = 'drop') 
  
  plot(df$year, df$deficit_obs, main = site)
  
  df_disturbance <- bind_rows(df_disturbance, df)
}
#
write.csv(df_disturbance, file = file.path("data2026", 'LAI_reduction_disturbance.csv'), row.names = F)
```

```{r calculate environmental conditions of carbon trends during each period}
library(librarian)
shelf(lme4, ggplot2, tidyverse, lmerTest, ggpubr)
#
rm_years <- read.csv(file.path('data2026', 'years_to_remove.csv'))
sites_long <- read.csv(file.path('data2026', 'long_term_ec_sites.csv'))
a_YY_co2 <- read.csv(file.path("data2026", "a_YY_co2_gap_filled.csv"))
a_YY_Cflux <- read.csv(file.path("data2026", "a_YY_carbon_flux_all.csv"))
#
source(file.path("scripts2026", "00_functions.R"))
df_file_structure <- get_rawflux_file_structure(dir_rawdata)
#
# we need to differentiate growing and non-growing season for SWC
a_DD_SWC <- read.csv(file.path(dir_rawdata, "ERA5L_daily_SWC_trend_allsites_1990_2025_correct.csv"))
a_DD_SWC$date <- ymd(a_DD_SWC$date)
# date, name, SWC
# growing season measured SWC for a separate site GL-ZaH. 
SWC_week_GL_ZaH <- read.csv(file.path(dir_rawdata, "publication", "GL-ZaH_soil_moisuture.csv"))
SWC_YY_GL_ZaH <- SWC_week_GL_ZaH %>% mutate(Date = mdy(Date)) %>%
  mutate(year = year(Date), month = month(Date)) %>% 
  filter(between(month, 6, 8)) %>% 
  group_by(year) %>% summarise(SWC = (mean(SWC_10cm) + mean(SWC_10cm)) / 2)
# the added values are based on FLUXNET shuttle SWC data in 2001:2004
SWC_YY_GL_ZaH <- bind_rows(data.frame(year = c(2001, 2002), SWC = c(25.53, 23.27)), SWC_YY_GL_ZaH)
#
a_YY_SWC <- a_DD_SWC %>% mutate(year = year(a_DD_SWC$date)) %>%
  group_by(name, year) %>% summarise(SWC_ERA5 = mean(SWC, na.rm = T))
#
data_grow_season <- read.csv(file.path('data2026', 'growing_season_yearly.csv'))
grow_season_site <- data_grow_season %>%
  group_by(site_ID) %>% 
  summarise(sos=floor((mean(sos_DER) + mean(sos_TRS)) / 2), 
            eos=ceiling((mean(eos_DER) + mean(eos_TRS)) / 2))

# get growing seasons for all sites. 
source(file.path("scripts2026", "00_functions.R"))
grow_season_site <- bind_rows(grow_season_site, data.frame(site_ID = sites_grow_yearlong, sos = 1, eos = 365))
#
# if (!'category' %in% names(a_YY_all)) {
#   a_YY_all <- a_YY_all %>% left_join(sites_long[, c("site_ID", "IGBP", "Climate.class", "category")], by = "site_ID")
# }
trend_driver <- data.frame(site_ID = character(), year_mid = integer(), nyear = integer(), 
                           year_start = integer(), year_end = integer(),
                     NEE = double(), GPP = double(), ER = double(), 
                     LE = double(), SW = double(), GPP_at_mean = double(), 
                     NEE_t = double(), NEE_p = double(), NEE_at = double(),  NEE_at_sd = double(),     # at: actual trend; _sd standard deviation
                     GPP_t = double(), GPP_p = double(), GPP_at = double(), 
                     ER_t = double(), ER_p = double(), ER_at = double(), 
                     TA_t=double(), TA_p=double(), TA_at=double(), 
                     TA_gs_t=double(), TA_gs_p=double(), TA_gs_at=double(), 
                     TA_ngs_t=double(), TA_ngs_p=double(), TA_ngs_at=double(), 
                     P_t=double(), P_p=double(), P_at=double(), 
                     P_gs_t=double(), P_gs_p=double(), P_gs_at=double(), 
                     P_ngs_t=double(), P_ngs_p=double(), P_ngs_at=double(), 
                     VPD_t=double(), VPD_p=double(), VPD_at=double(), 
                     VPD_gs_t=double(), VPD_gs_p=double(), VPD_gs_at=double(), 
                     VPD_ngs_t=double(), VPD_ngs_p=double(), VPD_ngs_at=double(), 
                     SWC_t=double(), SWC_p=double(), SWC_at=double(), 
                     SWC_gs_t=double(), SWC_gs_p=double(), SWC_gs_at=double(), 
                     SWC_ngs_t=double(), SWC_ngs_p=double(), SWC_ngs_at=double(), 
                     SW_t=double(), SW_p=double(), SW_at=double(), 
                     SW_gs_t=double(), SW_gs_p=double(), SW_gs_at=double(), 
                     SW_ngs_t=double(), SW_ngs_p=double(), SW_ngs_at=double(), 
                     LE_t=double(), LE_p=double(), LE_at=double(), 
                     LE_gs_t=double(), LE_gs_p=double(), LE_gs_at=double(), 
                     LE_ngs_t=double(), LE_ngs_p=double(), LE_ngs_at=double(), 
                     CO2=double(), CO2_at=double(), CO2_p=double(), 
                     Lgs_t=double(), Lgs_p=double(), Lgs_at=double(), 
                     Lgs_piece_t=double(), Lgs_piece_p=double(), Lgs_piece_at=double(),
                     DIST_t=double(), DIST_p=double(), DIST_at=double(), 
                     MAT=double(), MAP=double())

# yearly data used to calculate trends
data_trend_driver <- data.frame()

# get trends using local regressions
window_size = 15
nobsv_min = max(window_size * 0.5, 8)
#
df_daily_prec <- read.csv(file.path("data2026", "daily_ERA5_prec_36sites.csv"))
df_daily_prec$date <- as.Date(df_daily_prec$date)
sites_prec_issues <- unique(df_daily_prec$site_ID)
#
id = 1
for (i in 1:nrow(sites_long)) {
  print(i)
  site_ID <- sites_long$site_ID[i]
  #
  print(site_ID)
  folder <- unlist(df_file_structure$folders[df_file_structure$sources == sites_long$source[i]])
  DDfile <- df_file_structure$DDfiles[df_file_structure$sources == sites_long$source[i]]
  YYfile <- df_file_structure$YYfiles[df_file_structure$sources == sites_long$source[i]]
  #
  a_DD <- read.csv(folder[grepl(pattern=paste0(site_ID, DDfile), folder)])
  a_YY <- read.csv(folder[grepl(pattern=paste0(site_ID, YYfile), folder)])
  a_DD[a_DD==-9999] <- NA
  a_YY[a_YY==-9999] <- NA
  
  #### use gap-filled NEE_VUT_REF, GPP and ER
  if (sites_long$NEEpartition[i] == 'DT') {
    a_YY <- a_YY %>%
    left_join(a_YY_Cflux %>% filter(site_ID == sites_long$site_ID[i]) %>%
                dplyr::select(TIMESTAMP, NEE_fill = NEE_VUT_REF, GPP_fill = GPP_DT_VUT_REF, RECO_fill = RECO_DT_VUT_REF), by = "TIMESTAMP") %>%
    mutate(NEE_VUT_REF = coalesce(NEE_VUT_REF, NEE_fill), 
           GPP_DT_VUT_REF = coalesce(GPP_DT_VUT_REF, GPP_fill), 
           RECO_DT_VUT_REF = coalesce(RECO_DT_VUT_REF, RECO_fill)) %>%
    dplyr::select(-NEE_fill, -GPP_fill, -RECO_fill)
  } else if (sites_long$NEEpartition[i] == 'NT') {
    a_YY <- a_YY %>%
    left_join(a_YY_Cflux %>% filter(site_ID == sites_long$site_ID[i]) %>%
            dplyr::select(TIMESTAMP, NEE_fill = NEE_VUT_REF, GPP_fill = GPP_NT_VUT_REF, RECO_fill = RECO_NT_VUT_REF), by = "TIMESTAMP") %>%
    mutate(NEE_VUT_REF = coalesce(NEE_VUT_REF, NEE_fill), 
           GPP_NT_VUT_REF = coalesce(GPP_NT_VUT_REF, GPP_fill), 
           RECO_NT_VUT_REF = coalesce(RECO_NT_VUT_REF, RECO_fill)) %>%
    dplyr::select(-NEE_fill, -GPP_fill, -RECO_fill)    
  }
  ####
  
  #
  a_DD$TIMESTAMP <- ymd(a_DD$TIMESTAMP)
  a_DD <- a_DD %>% mutate(year=year(a_DD$TIMESTAMP), doy=yday(a_DD$TIMESTAMP))
  
  # remove bad NEE years
  a_YY <- a_YY %>% filter(!TIMESTAMP %in% rm_years$years[rm_years$site_ID==site_ID])
  
  # update CO2 data in a_YY
  co2_site <- a_YY_co2[a_YY_co2$site_ID == site_ID, c("TIMESTAMP", "CO2_F_MDS")]

  # replace or update CO2_F_MDS in a_YY
  a_YY <- a_YY %>% mutate(CO2_F_MDS = co2_site$CO2_F_MDS[match(TIMESTAMP, co2_site$TIMESTAMP)])
  #
  # add ERA5 SWC into a_YY and a_DD
  a_DD <- a_DD %>% left_join(a_DD_SWC[a_DD_SWC$name == site_ID, c("date", "SWC")], by = c("TIMESTAMP" = "date")) %>%
    rename(SWC_ERA5 = SWC)
  a_YY <- a_YY %>% left_join(a_YY_SWC[a_YY_SWC$name == site_ID, ], by = c("TIMESTAMP" = 'year'))
  
  # use the south of -10 degree to be consistent with growing season detection.
  if (sites_long$Lat[i] < -10) {
    a_DD$doy <- southern_hemisphere_doy(a_DD$TIMESTAMP)
  }
  #
  # remove bad years and select the correct years
  a_DD <- a_DD %>% filter(!year %in% rm_years$years[rm_years$site_ID==site_ID])
  
  # remove bad years for IT-Noe, we used FLUXNET2025 data
  if (site_ID == "IT-Noe") {
    a_YY[a_YY$TIMESTAMP %in% c(2015:2022), c("TA_F_MDS", "VPD_F_MDS", "SW_IN_F_MDS", "LE_F_MDS")] = NA  # bad data
    a_DD[a_DD$year %in% c(2015:2022), c("TA_F_MDS", "VPD_F_MDS", "SW_IN_F_MDS", "LE_F_MDS")] = NA  # bad data
  }
  
  # remove low-quality data
  if ("TA_F_MDS_QC" %in% names(a_YY)) {
    a_YY$TA_F_MDS[a_YY$TA_F_MDS_QC < 0.9] <- NA
    if (sites_long$source[i] == "FLUXNET_shuttle") { a_YY$TA_F_MDS[is.na(a_YY$TA_F_MDS_QC)] <- NA }
  }
  if ("VPD_F_MDS_QC" %in% names(a_YY)) {
    a_YY$VPD_F_MDS[a_YY$VPD_F_MDS_QC <  median(a_YY$VPD_F_MDS_QC, na.rm=T) * 0.7] <- NA
    if (sites_long$source[i] == "FLUXNET_shuttle") { a_YY$VPD_F_MDS[is.na(a_YY$VPD_F_MDS_QC)] <- NA }
  }
  if ("SW_IN_F_MDS_QC" %in% names(a_YY)) {
    a_YY$SW_IN_F_MDS[a_YY$SW_IN_F_MDS_QC < median(a_YY$SW_IN_F_MDS_QC, na.rm=T) * 0.7] <- NA
    if (sites_long$source[i] == "FLUXNET_shuttle") { a_YY$SW_IN_F_MDS[is.na(a_YY$SW_IN_F_MDS_QC)] <- NA }
  }
  if ("LE_F_MDS_QC" %in% names(a_YY)) {
    a_YY$LE_F_MDS[a_YY$LE_F_MDS_QC < median(a_YY$LE_F_MDS_QC, na.rm=T) * 0.7] <- NA
    if (sites_long$source[i] == "FLUXNET_shuttle") { a_YY$LE_F_MDS[is.na(a_YY$LE_F_MDS_QC)] <- NA }
  }

  # merge _F_MDS_ with ERA5
  years_na <- a_YY$TIMESTAMP[is.na(a_YY$TA_F_MDS)]
  if (length(years_na) > 0) {
    a_DD$TA_F_MDS[a_DD$year %in% years_na] <- NA
    if (nrow(a_YY) - length(years_na) > 5 && "TA_ERA" %in% names(a_YY)) {
      a_YY$TA_F_MDS <- merge_ERA_FLUX(years_na, a_YY$TIMESTAMP, a_YY$TA_F_MDS, a_YY$TA_ERA)
      a_DD$TA_F_MDS <- merge_ERA_FLUX(years_na, a_DD$year, a_DD$TA_F_MDS, a_DD$TA_ERA)
    } else {
      a_YY$TA_F_MDS <- coalesce(!!!dplyr::select(a_YY, any_of(c("TA_F_MDS", "TA_F", "TA_ERA"))))
      a_DD$TA_F_MDS <- coalesce(!!!dplyr::select(a_DD, any_of(c("TA_F_MDS", "TA_F", "TA_ERA"))))
    } 
  }
  #
  years_na <- a_YY$TIMESTAMP[is.na(a_YY$VPD_F_MDS)]
  if (length(years_na) > 0) {
    a_DD$VPD_F_MDS[a_DD$year %in% years_na] <- NA
    if (nrow(a_YY) - length(years_na) > 5 && "VPD_ERA" %in% names(a_YY)) {
      a_YY$VPD_F_MDS <- merge_ERA_FLUX(years_na, a_YY$TIMESTAMP, a_YY$VPD_F_MDS, a_YY$VPD_ERA)
      a_DD$VPD_F_MDS <- merge_ERA_FLUX(years_na, a_DD$year, a_DD$VPD_F_MDS, a_DD$VPD_ERA)
    } else {
      a_YY$VPD_F_MDS <- coalesce(!!!dplyr::select(a_YY, any_of(c("VPD_F_MDS", "VPD_F", "VPD_ERA"))))
      a_DD$VPD_F_MDS <- coalesce(!!!dplyr::select(a_DD, any_of(c("VPD_F_MDS", "VPD_F", "VPD_ERA"))))
    }
  }
  #
  years_na <- a_YY$TIMESTAMP[is.na(a_YY$SW_IN_F_MDS)]
  if (length(years_na) > 0) {
    a_DD$SW_IN_F_MDS[a_DD$year %in% years_na] <- NA
    if (nrow(a_YY) - length(years_na) > 5 && "SW_IN_ERA" %in% names(a_YY)) {
      a_YY$SW_IN_F_MDS <- merge_ERA_FLUX(years_na, a_YY$TIMESTAMP, a_YY$SW_IN_F_MDS, a_YY$SW_IN_ERA)
      a_DD$SW_IN_F_MDS <- merge_ERA_FLUX(years_na, a_DD$year, a_DD$SW_IN_F_MDS, a_DD$SW_IN_ERA)
    } else {
      a_YY$SW_IN_F_MDS <- coalesce(!!!dplyr::select(a_YY, any_of(c("SW_IN_F_MDS", "SW_IN_F", "SW_IN_ERA"))))
      a_DD$SW_IN_F_MDS <- coalesce(!!!dplyr::select(a_DD, any_of(c("SW_IN_F_MDS", "SW_IN_F", "SW_IN_ERA"))))
    }
  }

  if (site_ID %in% c("CA-Ca1", "IT-Noe", "US-Los", "US-Rws")) {
    # filled TA may be problematic, directly use ERA5 data
    a_DD$TA_F_MDS <- a_DD$TA_ERA
    a_DD$VPD_F_MDS <- a_DD$VPD_ERA
    a_YY$TA_F_MDS <- a_YY$TA_ERA
    a_YY$VPD_F_MDS <- a_YY$VPD_ERA
  }
  if (site_ID %in% c("ES-Agu", "ES-LJu", "CN-Din", "US-Syv", "US-ALQ")) {
    a_YY$SW_IN_F_MDS = a_YY$SW_IN_ERA    # the recent SW_IN_F_MDS should be replaced.
    a_DD$SW_IN_F_MDS = a_DD$SW_IN_ERA
  }

  # these sites' precipitation is not consistent with reported values, and we used downloaded ERA5 precp. 
  if (site_ID %in% sites_prec_issues) {
    df_daily_prec_site <- df_daily_prec[df_daily_prec$site_ID == site_ID, ]
    if (nrow(df_daily_prec_site) > 0) {
      a_DD <- a_DD %>% dplyr::select(-P_ERA) %>% left_join(df_daily_prec_site, by = c('TIMESTAMP'='date'))
      #
      df_yearly <- df_daily_prec_site %>% mutate(year = year(date)) %>% 
        group_by(year) %>% 
        summarise(P_ERA = if (all(is.na(P_ERA))) NA_real_ else sum(P_ERA, na.rm = T), .groups = 'drop')
      a_YY <- a_YY %>% dplyr::select(-P_ERA) %>% left_join(df_yearly, by = c('TIMESTAMP'='year'))
      # This site's precipitation is slightly higher than reported, so we applied a ratio. 
      if (site_ID %in% c("CH-Aws")) {
        ratio = sites_long$MAP[i] / mean(a_YY$P_ERA, na.rm = T)
        a_YY$P_ERA = a_YY$P_ERA * ratio
        a_DD$P_ERA = a_DD$P_ERA * ratio        
      }
    } 
  }  
  #############start plot figures for data quality check##########
  # plot(a_DD$TIMESTAMP, a_DD$TA_F_MDS, main=site_ID)
  # plot(a_YY$TIMESTAMP, a_YY$TA_F_MDS, main=site_ID)
  # #
  # plot(a_DD$TIMESTAMP, a_DD$VPD_F_MDS, main=site_ID)
  # plot(a_YY$TIMESTAMP, a_YY$VPD_F_MDS, main=site_ID)
  # 
  # plot(a_DD$TIMESTAMP, a_DD$SWC_ERA5, main=site_ID)
  # plot(a_YY$TIMESTAMP, a_YY$SWC_ERA5, main=site_ID)
  # #
  # plot(a_DD$TIMESTAMP, a_DD$SW_IN_F_MDS, main=site_ID)
  # plot(a_YY$TIMESTAMP, a_YY$SW_IN_F_MDS, main=site_ID)
  # #
  # plot(a_DD$TIMESTAMP, a_DD$LE_F_MDS, main=site_ID)
  # plot(a_YY$TIMESTAMP, a_YY$LE_F_MDS, main=site_ID)
  # #
  # plot(a_DD$TIMESTAMP, a_DD$P_ERA, main=site_ID)
  # plot(a_YY$TIMESTAMP, a_YY$P_ERA, main=site_ID)
  # #
  # if ( is_col_exist(a_DD, "CO2_F_MDS") ) {
  #   plot(a_DD$TIMESTAMP, a_DD$CO2_F_MDS, main=site_ID)
  #   plot(a_YY$TIMESTAMP, a_YY$CO2_F_MDS, main=site_ID)
  # }
  #############end plot figures for data quality check##########
  # check MAT and MAP: "US-Cwt" may be too low; "CH-Aws" may be too high; "US-PFa": too low; "US-UMd"; "US-Tw1"; "US-Syv"; "US-Rws"; "US-Rms"; "US-KFS"; "US-EML"; "CA-TP3"; "CA-Ca1"; more inconsistent: CA-Cbo, IT-MBo, US-MBP, US-NC4
  # if (!is.na(sites_long[i, "MAT"]) & abs(sites_long[i, "MAT"] - mean(a_YY$TA_F_MDS, na.rm=T)) > 3) {
  #   print(paste0("MAT may have problems--", sites_long[i, "MAT"], "--", mean(a_YY$TA_F_MDS, na.rm=T)))
  # }
  # if (!is.na(sites_long[i, "MAP"]) & abs(sites_long[i, "MAP"] - mean(a_YY$P_ERA, na.rm=T)) > 0.15*sites_long[i, "MAP"]) {
  #   print(paste0("MAP may have problems--", sites_long[i, "MAP"], "--", mean(a_YY$P_ERA, na.rm=T)))
  # }
  
  # It is recommended not doing this
  ## Get yearly GPP, if we know NEE and ER. This ensures that NEE = ER - GPP 
  # if ("GPP_NT_VUT_REF" %in% names(a_YY)) {
  #   idx <- is.na(a_YY$GPP_NT_VUT_REF) & !is.na(a_YY$RECO_NT_VUT_REF) & !is.na(a_YY$NEE_VUT_REF)   
  #   a_YY$GPP_NT_VUT_REF[idx] <- a_YY$RECO_NT_VUT_REF[idx] - a_YY$NEE_VUT_REF[idx]
  # }
  # if ("GPP_DT_VUT_REF" %in% names(a_YY)) {
  #   idx <- is.na(a_YY$GPP_DT_VUT_REF) & !is.na(a_YY$RECO_DT_VUT_REF) & !is.na(a_YY$NEE_VUT_REF)       
  #   a_YY$RECO_DT_VUT_REF[idx] <- a_YY$GPP_DT_VUT_REF[idx] + a_YY$NEE_VUT_REF[idx]
  # }
  
  ## we differentiate TA, P, VPD, SW_IN, LE, SWC for growing and non-growing seasons
  # start and end of growing season
  sos <- grow_season_site$sos[grow_season_site$site_ID == site_ID]
  eos <- grow_season_site$eos[grow_season_site$site_ID == site_ID]
  a_YY_gw <- a_DD %>% filter(doy >= sos & doy <= eos) %>% group_by(year) %>% 
        summarise(TA_F_MDS=mean(TA_F_MDS, na.rm=T), P_ERA=sum(P_ERA, na.rm=T), 
                  VPD_F_MDS=mean(VPD_F_MDS, na.rm=T), SWC_ERA5=mean(SWC_ERA5, na.rm=T), 
                  SW_IN_F_MDS=mean(SW_IN_F_MDS, na.rm=T), LE_F_MDS=mean(LE_F_MDS, na.rm=T))
  a_YY_ngw <- a_DD %>% filter(doy < sos | doy > eos) %>% group_by(year) %>% 
        summarise(TA_F_MDS=mean(TA_F_MDS, na.rm=T), P_ERA=sum(P_ERA, na.rm=T), 
                  VPD_F_MDS=mean(VPD_F_MDS, na.rm=T), SWC_ERA5=mean(SWC_ERA5, na.rm=T), 
                  SW_IN_F_MDS=mean(SW_IN_F_MDS, na.rm=T), LE_F_MDS=mean(LE_F_MDS, na.rm=T))
  
  # deal with missed P_ERA data in some years
  missed_PERA_years <- a_YY$TIMESTAMP[is.na(a_YY$P_ERA)]
  a_YY_gw$P_ERA[a_YY_gw$year %in% missed_PERA_years] <- NA
  a_YY_ngw$P_ERA[a_YY_ngw$year %in% missed_PERA_years] <- NA
  # 
  if (site_ID %in% c("JP-Yms")) {
    # LE of these sites are mostly missing, using linear regression based on net radiation
    mod <- lm(data = a_YY, LE_F_MDS ~ GPP_NT_VUT_REF + SW_IN_F_MDS)
    a_YY$LE_F_MDS <- predict(mod, newdata = a_YY[, c("GPP_NT_VUT_REF", "SW_IN_F_MDS")])
    # 
    data_gw <- a_DD %>% filter(doy >= sos & doy <= eos) %>% group_by(year) %>% 
          summarise(GPP_NT_VUT_REF=mean(GPP_NT_VUT_REF, na.rm=T), SW_IN_F_MDS = mean(SW_IN_F_MDS, na.rm=T))
    a_YY_gw$LE_F_MDS <- predict(mod, newdata = data_gw)
    # 
    data_ngw <- a_DD %>% filter(doy < sos | doy > eos) %>% group_by(year) %>% 
          summarise(GPP_NT_VUT_REF=mean(GPP_NT_VUT_REF, na.rm=T), SW_IN_F_MDS = mean(SW_IN_F_MDS, na.rm=T))
    a_YY_ngw$LE_F_MDS <- predict(mod, newdata = data_ngw)
  }
  #----------------------
  #
  years <- a_YY$TIMESTAMP[!is.na(a_YY$NEE_VUT_REF)]
  year_start <- min(years) 
  year_end <- max(years)
  nwindow = max(year_end - year_start + 1 - window_size + 1, 1)
  # "ES-Agu" has a few gap years, and only 11-year full measurements, using one window only
  if (site_ID == "ES-Agu") { nwindow = 1}
  
  for (iwindow in 1:nwindow) {
    years_window <- (year_start + iwindow - 1):(year_start + iwindow + window_size - 2)
    
    if (site_ID == "ES-Agu") { years_window <- year_start:year_end }
    #
    # Process the special case: breakpoint in 2009 for the site BE-Vie. 
    if (site_ID == "BE-Vie") {
      period1 <- intersect(years_window, 1997:2008)
      period2 <- intersect(years_window, 2010:2024)
      if (length(period2) >= 10) {
        # use this site
        years_window <- period2
      } else if (length(period1) >= 10) {
        # use this site
        years_window <- period1
      } else {
        # do not use this site
        next
      }
    }
    #
    a_YY_sub <- a_YY %>% filter(TIMESTAMP %in% years_window)
    #
    a_YY_gw_sub <- a_YY_gw %>% filter(year %in% years_window)
    #a
    a_YY_ngw_sub <- a_YY_ngw %>% filter(year %in% years_window)
    #
    if (sum(!is.na(a_YY_sub$NEE_VUT_REF)) >= nobsv_min) {
      trend_driver[id, 'site_ID'] <- sites_long$site_ID[i]
      trend_driver[id, 'year_mid'] <- round(mean(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, na.rm=T))
      trend_driver[id, 'nyear'] <- length(unique(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP))
      trend_driver[id, 'year_start'] <- min(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, na.rm=T)
      trend_driver[id, 'year_end'] <- max(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, na.rm=T)
      # these carbon characteristics are site-specific and do not change with moving window
      trend_driver[id, 'NEE'] <- mean(a_YY$NEE_VUT_REF, na.rm=T)
      if (sites_long$NEEpartition[i] == 'NT') {
        trend_driver[id, 'GPP'] <- mean(a_YY$GPP_NT_VUT_REF, na.rm=T)
        trend_driver[id, 'ER'] <- mean(a_YY$RECO_NT_VUT_REF, na.rm=T)        
      } else {
        trend_driver[id, 'GPP'] <- mean(a_YY$GPP_DT_VUT_REF, na.rm=T)
        trend_driver[id, 'ER'] <- mean(a_YY$RECO_DT_VUT_REF, na.rm=T)
      }
      trend_driver[id, 'LE'] <- mean(a_YY$LE_F_MDS, na.rm=T)
      trend_driver[id, 'SW'] <- mean(a_YY$SW_IN_F_MDS, na.rm=T)
      #
      if (sites_long$NEEpartition[i] == 'DT') {
        trend_driver[id, 'GPP_at_mean'] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY$TIMESTAMP, a_YY$GPP_DT_VUT_REF)
      } else if (sites_long$NEEpartition[i] == 'NT') {
        trend_driver[id, 'GPP_at_mean'] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY$TIMESTAMP, a_YY$GPP_NT_VUT_REF)
      }
      #
      trend_driver[id, c('NEE_t', 'NEE_p')] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_sub$NEE_VUT_REF, a_YY$NEE_VUT_REF)
      trend_driver[id, c('NEE_at', 'NEE_at_sd')] <- cal_sens_slope_NEP(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_sub$NEE_VUT_REF)
      
      if (sites_long$NEEpartition[i] == 'DT') {
        if (sum(!is.na(a_YY_sub$GPP_DT_VUT_REF)) >= nobsv_min) {
          trend_driver[id, c('GPP_t', 'GPP_p')] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_sub$GPP_DT_VUT_REF, a_YY$GPP_DT_VUT_REF)
          trend_driver[id, c('GPP_at')] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_sub$GPP_DT_VUT_REF)
        }
        if (sum(!is.na(a_YY_sub$RECO_DT_VUT_REF)) >= nobsv_min) {
          trend_driver[id, c('ER_t', 'ER_p')] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_sub$RECO_DT_VUT_REF, a_YY$RECO_DT_VUT_REF)
          trend_driver[id, c('ER_at')] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_sub$RECO_DT_VUT_REF)
        }
      } else if (sites_long$NEEpartition[i] == 'NT') {
        if (sum(!is.na(a_YY_sub$GPP_NT_VUT_REF)) >= nobsv_min) {
          trend_driver[id, c('GPP_t', 'GPP_p')] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_sub$GPP_NT_VUT_REF, a_YY$GPP_NT_VUT_REF)
          trend_driver[id, c('GPP_at')] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_sub$GPP_NT_VUT_REF)
        }
        if (sum(!is.na(a_YY_sub$RECO_NT_VUT_REF)) >= nobsv_min) {
          trend_driver[id, c('ER_t', 'ER_p')] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_sub$RECO_NT_VUT_REF, a_YY$RECO_NT_VUT_REF)
          trend_driver[id, c('ER_at')] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_sub$RECO_NT_VUT_REF)
        }
      }
      #
      # calculate trends of environmental conditions
      trend_driver[id, c("TA_t", "TA_p")] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_sub$TA_F_MDS, a_YY$TA_F_MDS)
      trend_driver[id, c("TA_at")] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_sub$TA_F_MDS)
      trend_driver[id, c("TA_gs_t", "TA_gs_p")] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(a_YY_gw_sub$year, a_YY_gw_sub$TA_F_MDS, a_YY_gw$TA_F_MDS)
      trend_driver[id, c("TA_gs_at")] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_gw_sub$year, a_YY_gw_sub$TA_F_MDS)
      if (! site_ID %in% sites_grow_yearlong) {
        trend_driver[id, c("TA_ngs_t", "TA_ngs_p")] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(a_YY_ngw_sub$year, a_YY_ngw_sub$TA_F_MDS, a_YY_ngw$TA_F_MDS)
        trend_driver[id, c("TA_ngs_at")] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_ngw_sub$year, a_YY_ngw_sub$TA_F_MDS)
      }
      #
      # Note: we converted precipitation unit from mm/season to mm/day to exclude the varying effects of growing season legnth
      trend_driver[id, c("P_t", "P_p")] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_sub$P_ERA, a_YY$P_ERA)
      trend_driver[id, c("P_at")] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_sub$P_ERA) / 365.25
      trend_driver[id, c("P_gs_t", "P_gs_p")] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(a_YY_gw_sub$year, a_YY_gw_sub$P_ERA, a_YY_gw$P_ERA)
      trend_driver[id, c("P_gs_at")] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_gw_sub$year, a_YY_gw_sub$P_ERA) / (eos - sos + 1)
      if (! site_ID %in% sites_grow_yearlong) {
        trend_driver[id, c("P_ngs_t", "P_ngs_p")] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(a_YY_ngw_sub$year, a_YY_ngw_sub$P_ERA, a_YY_ngw$P_ERA)
        trend_driver[id, c("P_ngs_at")] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_ngw_sub$year, a_YY_ngw_sub$P_ERA) / (365.25 - (eos - sos + 1))
      }
      #
      trend_driver[id, c("VPD_t", "VPD_p")] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_sub$VPD_F_MDS, a_YY$VPD_F_MDS)
      trend_driver[id, c("VPD_at")] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_sub$VPD_F_MDS)
      trend_driver[id, c("VPD_gs_t", "VPD_gs_p")] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(a_YY_gw_sub$year, a_YY_gw_sub$VPD_F_MDS, a_YY_gw$VPD_F_MDS)
      trend_driver[id, c("VPD_gs_at")] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_gw_sub$year, a_YY_gw_sub$VPD_F_MDS)
      if (! site_ID %in% sites_grow_yearlong) {
        trend_driver[id, c("VPD_ngs_t", "VPD_ngs_p")] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(a_YY_ngw_sub$year, a_YY_ngw_sub$VPD_F_MDS, a_YY_ngw$VPD_F_MDS)
        trend_driver[id, c("VPD_ngs_at")] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_ngw_sub$year, a_YY_ngw_sub$VPD_F_MDS)
      }
      #
      if (site_ID %in% c('GL-ZaH')) {
        SWC_YY_GL_ZaH_sub <- SWC_YY_GL_ZaH %>% filter(year %in% years_window)
        trend_driver[id, c("SWC_t", "SWC_p")] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(SWC_YY_GL_ZaH_sub$year, SWC_YY_GL_ZaH_sub$SWC, SWC_YY_GL_ZaH$SWC)
        # SWC_at was inferred based on SWC_t ~ SWC_at relation of this climate-vegetation class
        trend_driver[id, c("SWC_at")] <- trend_driver[id, c("SWC_t")] * 1.2
        trend_driver[id, c("SWC_gs_t", "SWC_gs_p")] <- trend_driver[id, c("SWC_t", "SWC_p")]
        trend_driver[id, c("SWC_gs_at")] <- trend_driver[id, c("SWC_gs_t")] * 2.32
        trend_driver[id, c("SWC_ngs_t", "SWC_ngs_p")] <- c(0, 1)         # ice covered site, no trend
        trend_driver[id, c("SWC_ngs_at")] <- 0
      } else {
        trend_driver[id, c("SWC_t", "SWC_p")] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_sub$SWC_ERA5, a_YY$SWC_ERA5)
        trend_driver[id, c("SWC_at")] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_sub$SWC_ERA5)
        trend_driver[id, c("SWC_gs_t", "SWC_gs_p")] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(a_YY_gw_sub$year, a_YY_gw_sub$SWC_ERA5, a_YY_gw$SWC_ERA5)
        trend_driver[id, c("SWC_gs_at")] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_gw_sub$year, a_YY_gw_sub$SWC_ERA5)
        if (! site_ID %in% sites_grow_yearlong) {
          trend_driver[id, c("SWC_ngs_t", "SWC_ngs_p")] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(a_YY_ngw_sub$year, a_YY_ngw_sub$SWC_ERA5, a_YY_ngw$SWC_ERA5)
          trend_driver[id, c("SWC_ngs_at")] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_ngw_sub$year, a_YY_ngw_sub$SWC_ERA5)
        }
      }
      #
      trend_driver[id, c("SW_t", "SW_p")] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_sub$SW_IN_F_MDS, a_YY$SW_IN_F_MDS)
      trend_driver[id, c("SW_at")] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_sub$SW_IN_F_MDS)
      trend_driver[id, c("SW_gs_t", "SW_gs_p")] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(a_YY_gw_sub$year, a_YY_gw_sub$SW_IN_F_MDS, a_YY_gw$SW_IN_F_MDS)
      trend_driver[id, c("SW_gs_at")] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_gw_sub$year, a_YY_gw_sub$SW_IN_F_MDS)
      if (! site_ID %in% sites_grow_yearlong) {
        trend_driver[id, c("SW_ngs_t", "SW_ngs_p")] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(a_YY_ngw_sub$year, a_YY_ngw_sub$SW_IN_F_MDS, a_YY_ngw$SW_IN_F_MDS)
        trend_driver[id, c("SW_ngs_at")] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_ngw_sub$year, a_YY_ngw_sub$SW_IN_F_MDS)
      }
      #
      #
      trend_driver[id, c("LE_t", "LE_p")] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_sub$LE_F_MDS, a_YY$LE_F_MDS)
      trend_driver[id, c("LE_at")] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_sub$LE_F_MDS)
      trend_driver[id, c("LE_gs_t", "LE_gs_p")] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(a_YY_gw_sub$year, a_YY_gw_sub$LE_F_MDS, a_YY_gw$LE_F_MDS)
      trend_driver[id, c("LE_gs_at")] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_gw_sub$year, a_YY_gw_sub$LE_F_MDS)
      if (! site_ID %in% sites_grow_yearlong) {
        trend_driver[id, c("LE_ngs_t", "LE_ngs_p")] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(a_YY_ngw_sub$year, a_YY_ngw_sub$LE_F_MDS, a_YY_ngw$LE_F_MDS)
        trend_driver[id, c("LE_ngs_at")] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_ngw_sub$year, a_YY_ngw_sub$LE_F_MDS)
      }
      # for the two sites assuming its yearly LE trends = growing-season LE trends due to incomplete LE measurements
      if (site_ID %in% c("US-NC2", "US-NC4")) {
        trend_driver[id, c("LE_at")] <- trend_driver[id, c("LE_gs_at")]
      }
      #
      # left join a_YY, a_YY_gw, and a_YY_ngw and put data into a data frame
      a_YY_gw_rename <- a_YY_gw
      a_YY_ngw_rename <- a_YY_ngw
      if ("year" %in% names(a_YY_gw_rename)) {
        a_YY_gw_rename <- a_YY_gw_rename %>% rename('TIMESTAMP' = "year")
      }
      if ("year" %in% names(a_YY_ngw_rename)) {
        a_YY_ngw_rename <- a_YY_ngw_rename %>% rename('TIMESTAMP' = "year")
      }
      #
      varnames_select <- c("TIMESTAMP", "TA_F_MDS", "P_ERA", "VPD_F_MDS", "SWC_ERA5", "SW_IN_F_MDS", "LE_F_MDS")
      a_YY_gw_rename <- a_YY_gw_rename[, varnames_select]
      names(a_YY_gw_rename)[2:7] <- paste0(varnames_select[2:7], "_gw")
      a_YY_ngw_rename <- a_YY_ngw_rename[, varnames_select]
      names(a_YY_ngw_rename)[2:7] <- paste0(varnames_select[2:7], "_ngw")
      #
      merged_df <- merge(a_YY[, c("NEE_VUT_REF", varnames_select)], a_YY_gw_rename, by="TIMESTAMP")
      merged_df <- merge(merged_df, a_YY_ngw_rename, by="TIMESTAMP")
      merged_df$site_ID <- site_ID
      merged_df$isubts <- i
      data_trend_driver <- rbind(data_trend_driver, merged_df)
      #
      ## we do not differentiate CO2, Lgs for growing and non-growing seasons
      trend_driver[id, c("CO2_at")] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_sub$CO2_F_MDS)  
      trend_driver[id, c("CO2_p")] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_sub$CO2_F_MDS, a_YY$CO2_F_MDS)[2]
      trend_driver[id, c("CO2")] <- mean(a_YY_sub$CO2_F_MDS, na.rm = T)
      if (site_ID %in% sites_grow_yearlong) {
        trend_driver[id, c("Lgs_t", "Lgs_p", "Lgs_at")] <- 0
        trend_driver[id, c("Lgs_piece_t", "Lgs_piece_p", "Lgs_piece_at")] <- 0
      } else {
        data_grow_season_site <- data_grow_season[data_grow_season$site_ID==site_ID, ]
        subdata_grow_season <- data_grow_season_site %>% filter(year %in% years_window)
        if (sum(!is.na(subdata_grow_season$length_gs)) >= nobsv_min) {
          trend_driver[id, c("Lgs_t", "Lgs_p")] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(subdata_grow_season$year, subdata_grow_season$length_gs, data_grow_season_site$length_gs)
          trend_driver[id, c("Lgs_at")] <- cal_sens_slope(subdata_grow_season$year, subdata_grow_season$length_gs)
        }
        if (sum(!is.na(subdata_grow_season$length_gs_piece)) >= nobsv_min) {
          trend_driver[id, c("Lgs_piece_t", "Lgs_piece_p")] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(subdata_grow_season$year, subdata_grow_season$length_gs_piece, data_grow_season_site$length_gs_piece)
          trend_driver[id, c("Lgs_piece_at")] <- cal_sens_slope(subdata_grow_season$year, subdata_grow_season$length_gs_piece)
        }
        # ###########################start plot figures for data quality check##################
        # plot(subdata_grow_season$year, subdata_grow_season$length_gs, main=site_ID)
        # plot(subdata_grow_season$year, subdata_grow_season$length_gs_piece, main=site_ID)
        # ###########################end plot figures for data quality check####################
      }
      
      # disturbance conditions
      df_disturbance_site <- df_disturbance[df_disturbance$ID==site_ID, ]
      subdata_disturbance <- df_disturbance_site %>% filter(year %in% years_window)
      if (sum(!is.na(subdata_disturbance$deficit_obs)) >= nobsv_min) {
        # we need at least 5-year data to get a reliable trend.
        trend_driver[id, c("DIST_t", "DIST_p")] <- cal_sens_slope_scale(subdata_disturbance$year, subdata_disturbance$deficit_obs, df_disturbance_site$deficit_obs) # deficit_obs
        trend_driver[id, c("DIST_at")] <- cal_sens_slope(subdata_disturbance$year, subdata_disturbance$deficit_obs)
      } else {
        trend_driver[id, c("DIST_t", "DIST_p")] <- NA
        trend_driver[id, c("DIST_at")] <- NA
      }
      
      # Baseline conditions: MAT, MAP; use our TNvalues if we have >10 year data
      if (is.na(sites_long$MAT[sites_long$site_ID==site_ID])) {
        trend_driver[id, "MAT"] <- mean(a_YY$TA_F_MDS, na.rm=T)
        trend_driver[id, "MAP"] <- mean(a_YY$P_ERA, na.rm=T)
      } else {
        trend_driver[id, "MAT"] <- sites_long$MAT[sites_long$site_ID==site_ID]
        trend_driver[id, "MAP"] <- sites_long$MAP[sites_long$site_ID==site_ID]
      }
      id = id + 1
    }
  }
}

# LE data for the Lost Creek before 2010 is problematic, and not used. 
trend_driver[trend_driver$site_ID == "US-Los" & trend_driver$year_mid < 2011, c("LE_t", "LE_p", "LE_at", "LE_gs_t", "LE_gs_p", "LE_gs_at", "LE_ngs_t", "LE_ngs_p", "LE_ngs_at")] <- NA
trend_driver[trend_driver$site_ID == "JP-Tak", c("LE", "LE_t", "LE_p", "LE_at", "LE_gs_t", "LE_gs_p", "LE_gs_at", "LE_ngs_t", "LE_ngs_p", "LE_ngs_at")] <- NA

# set disturbance at Ha1 (the earliest site) in the 1990s due to no LAI observations
if (any(is.na(trend_driver$DIST_at[trend_driver$site_ID == 'US-Ha1']))) {
  id_row <- which(is.na(trend_driver$DIST_at) & trend_driver$site_ID == 'US-Ha1')
  trend_driver[id_row, "DIST_at"] <- trend_driver[max(id_row) + 1, "DIST_at"]
  trend_driver[id_row, "DIST_t"] <- trend_driver[max(id_row) + 1, "DIST_t"]
  trend_driver[id_row, "DIST_p"] <- trend_driver[max(id_row) + 1, "DIST_p"]
}

trend_driver_filter <- trend_driver %>%
  group_by(site_ID) %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  filter(!map_lgl(row_id, function(i) {
    any(
      year_start[i] >= year_start[-i] &
        year_end[i] <= year_end[-i]
    )
  })) %>% ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-row_id) %>%
  filter(year_end - year_start + 1 >= data_length_thresh) 


write.csv(trend_driver_filter, file.path("data2026", "potential_trend_driver.csv"), row.names = F)
```
